verdict.rationale: Exporting gateway logs and traces is a fair question for an LLM gateway, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows Requesty's own in-product analytics dashboards: real-time cost, token and latency tracking, plus MCP usage analytics. Nothing documents exporting logs or traces to an external observability stack (for example OpenTelemetry, webhooks, log drains or third-party integrations), and the trace_id mention concerns sticky load-balancing, not trace export.
